title: post: parse and validate optional kinematics.default.urdf in .mch

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Add the optional `kinematics.default.urdf` block to the `.mch` machine-file grammar and validator.

## Context
Research in #2593 selected a file contract for URDF machine models (for example, exports from SolidCraft). The `.mch` file names the URDF file and maps each `.mch` axis letter to one URDF joint. Existing `.mch` files without `urdf` keep reading unchanged.

## Scope
- Add pure data types (`UrdfSpec`, `UrdfJointMap`, `UrdfRootFrame`) in `camcraft-post::machine` and store `pub urdf: Option<UrdfSpec>` on `MachineTree` (`crates/post/src/machine/tree.rs`).
- Parse `kinematics.default.urdf`:
  - `file` (required): non-empty relative path string. Refuse absolute paths, null bytes, and URL schemes (`http://`, `https://`, `package://`).
  - `joints` (required): JSON object keyed by axis letter (case-folded to uppercase, matching `controller.synced_configuration.parts`). Each value is either a non-empty joint-name string (`sign = 1`, `zero = 0.0`) or an object `{ "joint": "<name>", "sign": 1 | -1, "zero": <finite> }`. Scale `zero` by `mm_factor` for linear axes and keep degrees for rotary axes.
  - `root_frame` (optional): `{ "offset": [x, y, z], "rpy": [rx, ry, rz] }`. Scale `offset` by `mm_factor` to mm; keep `rpy` in degrees; refuse non-finite values.
  - `tool_link` and `table_link` (optional): non-empty strings.
- Enforce strict named refusals (shared helper `urdf_refusals`, called by both `parse_mch_tree` and `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs`):
  - Refuse unknown keys inside `urdf`, `root_frame`, and any joint entry.
  - Refuse any driven axis in `kinematics.default.parts` that is missing from `urdf.joints`, and any letter in `urdf.joints` that is absent from `parts`.
  - Refuse duplicate letters (ignoring case) and two letters mapped to the same URDF joint name.
  - Refuse a `.mch` file that states both `kinematics.default.urdf` and per-part `body` (#2591) when `body` is present.
- Document the `kinematics.default.urdf` grammar and refusal rules in `assets/machines/AGENTS.md`.
- Keep `Machine` (`parse_mch`) and all existing `.mch` files unchanged in behaviour.

## Done means
`camcraft-post` parses `kinematics.default.urdf` into `MachineTree` with metric and inch unit scaling, `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` enforces the same named refusals, `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` documents the schema, and tests pin valid configs (string and object joint forms, `root_frame`, inch scaling) and every named refusal.

Part of #2593
